BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to motorcycle profiling; and adding a new sectionto chapter 43.101 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.101 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The criminal justice training commission and the Washingtonstate patrol shall ensure that issues related to motorcycle profilingare addressed in basic law enforcement training and offered to inservice law enforcement officers in conjunction with existing trainingregarding profiling. (2) State and local law enforcement agencies shall add a statementcondemning motorcycle profiling to existing policies regardingprofiling. (3) For the purposes of this section, "motorcycle profiling" meansusing solely the fact that a person is riding a motorcycle or iswearing certain motorcyclerelated paraphernalia while riding amotorcycle as a pretext in deciding whether or not to stop, detain, p. 1 SHB 1333question, search, or arrest a person operating a motorcycle.
